title: Detection of residual aneuploid leukemic cells by "continuous gating".
abstract: A new method for the detection of residual aneuploid leukemic cells in bone marrow by flow cytometry is described. This method is based on the analysis of FCM derived list-mode-datasets with a new software called "Continuous Gating". The program is able to decrease the detection level of aneuploid tumor cells by analyzing groups of cells with comparable antigen density and scatter properties.
